title: Phase 2 ODC review result
description: One reviewer's record for one frozen SWE-smith case, under the ODC Defect Type dimension only. This file is the documented contract. It is enforced in code by agentfailuretransfer.phase2.review_records, which implements the same checks without adding a jsonschema dependency; a test asserts that the code's enum lists are exactly the enums below, so the two cannot drift apart. Codex writes one such record per case as JSON, Claude as YAML; the semantics are identical.

case_id.description: The neutral frozen case id, SWESMITH_001 through SWESMITH_100. It must equal the record's file name stem.

odc_defect_type.description: The single ODC Defect Type that best describes the semantics of the correction required to repair the observed defect. UNCLASSIFIABLE is a study-level sentinel, not an ODC defect type.

taxonomy_fit.description: DIRECT: one ODC type clearly fits. AMBIGUOUS: more than one is plausible and the reviewer selected the best primary type. OUT_OF_SCOPE: none of the eight can be defensibly assigned.

pattern_confidence.description: Descriptive only. It is never used as an inclusion criterion.

supporting_evidence_ids.description: Evidence ids cited from this case's frozen packet, for example BUG_DIFF or CODE_CONTEXT_01. Every id must appear in that packet's evidence_ids.

reasoning_summary.description: Short, evidence-based justification of the chosen defect type. Classify the software defect and the semantics of its correction; do not reason about what the synthetic bug generator intended.

allOf.description: The sentinel implies the out-of-scope fit.
The out-of-scope fit implies the sentinel.
